info.title: ePing
info.description: Returns SPS and TBT notifications that are in the ePing website. Allows external applications/systems to search for notifications programatically.

get.description: Searches TBT and SPS notifications in ePing

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the notifications you are requesting (1 - English, 2 - French, 3 - Spanish)

parameters.name: domainIds
parameters.description: Domain of the notification you want to retrieve, either 1 - TBT, 2 - SPS. Not specifying the domainIds will return notifications for both TBT and SPS

parameters.name: documentSymbol
parameters.description: Search for a particular document symbol. Specifying "USA/1234" (without the quotes) will return all notifications where the document symbol contains "USA/1234" (e.g. G/TBT/N/USA/1234, G/SPS/N/USA/1234, G/SPS/N/USA/1234/Add.1, etc.)

parameters.name: distributionDateFrom
parameters.description: Search for notifications which are issued on or after the date specified in this parameter. yyyy-MM-dd format. Specifying 2022-08-01 will return notifications that were issued on or after 8 August 8, 2022.

parameters.name: distributionDateTo
parameters.description: Search for notifications which are issued on or before the date specified in this parameter. yyyy-MM-dd format. Specifying "2022-08-01" will return notifications that were issued on or before 8 August 8, 2022.

parameters.name: countryIds
parameters.description: Search for notifications issued by a particular Member. See members API for list of Country Ids (use value field)

parameters.name: hs
parameters.description: Search for notifications related to specified HS Codes. To search for multiple HS Codes, submit comma-separated values of HS Codes (e.g. 0102,0103,etc.). When combined with "ics" parameter, system performs an "OR" condition (e.g. &hs=01,02&ics=01.030,01.040 will return notifications related to HS 01 OR HS 02 OR ICS 01.030 OR ICS 01.040)

parameters.name: ics
parameters.description: Search for notifications related to specified ICS Codes. To search for multiple ICS Codes, submit comma-separated values of ICS Codes (e.g. 0102,0103,etc.). When combined with "hs" parameter, system performs an "OR" condition (e.g. &hs=01,02&ics=01.030,01.040 will return notifications related to HS 01 OR HS 02 OR ICS 01.030 OR ICS 01.040)

parameters.name: freeText
parameters.description: Search for any term related to a notification.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number of the notifications you want to retrieve. Default value is 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of notifications to be retrieved per call. Default value is 20. Maximum value is 100.

items.title: Notice.  Notice of Filing of a Pesticide Petition for the Establishment of a Regulation for the Residues of the Fungicide Epoxiconazole in or on Coffee Beans (Available in English, 2 pages).
items.description: This notice announces the initial filing of a pesticide petition proposing the establishment of a regulation for residues of the fungicide epoxiconazole, (2RS, 3SR)-3-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-(4-fluorophenyl)-2-[(1H-1, 2, 4-triazol-1-yl) methyl] oxirane in or on coffee beans.
